firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: the h1 'Your car's code, in plain English.' is the thesis, a green 'Auto Diagnosis & Repair in Billings, MT.' line sits right under it, and P0420 / 'Catalyst below threshold' now heads the live-data panel, so the left column reads h1, place, lead, actions, proof. The next band peeks. The proof line breaks '4.9 from / 228 reviews' across two lines with the pill orphaned (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: h1 in 4 lines, both actions above the fold, sticky call bar.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the mono reading over a plain sentence now carries the hero panel, the scan list, the readings, the I-90 road-test chart (P0303 · CYL 3 · 74 MPH), the printouts, the decoder, the brake pads and the footer. Section eyebrows are cut to 3. Siblings A and C differ. Near-black #0D1117 with signal green still reads as an editor dark theme (1440-first.jpg, -0.5).

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Syne extended against Figtree, curly quotes, en-dash ranges, the I-90 headline full measure. '$110–$180' now holds one line but is set a clear step smaller than 4.9 and 22 yrs, so the three numbers no longer share a size (-0.5). Tiny tracked mono caps remain dense around the Sample pills (1440-scroll-50.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the tone run alternates cleanly and the road-test chart gives the break a real object. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the brake steps are now a compact stack beside the diagram. The left half below the diagram is still empty for the pin, and the motion-on full page leaves about 1,000px of bare paper before 'Book a drop-off' (1440-full.jpg, -0.5).

photo.notes: 1440-first.jpg, 1440-full.jpg (I-90 road-test chart), 1440-scroll-75.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the drawn live-data panels, pad cross-section and dash icons are one well-made, on-concept system, and the brown-blur photo is gone. The page now carries no photograph at all, so a homeowner never sees a bay, a car or a person's hands (-0.5). Placeholder library, nothing blank, no mustFix.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: one action name now, 'Book a drop-off' (6×) with 'Price it' only as the row link, and the h1 states the promise. The voice is exact ('A long drive on I-90 is a bad place to find out the code was wrong.', 'You get the number, not “they're getting low”'). Facts are faithful and every review, rating, price, years figure and term carries a Sample pill. 'Nothing is sent from this sample' sits under the form (1440-full.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: the scan list now uses an inline PRICE IT link on the label row and is about half as long. The brake pin becomes re-drawn pad cards (the 0 mm card shows sparks), drop-off becomes a vertical rail, and the decoder runs 2 columns with the output stacked below. 390-first.jpg has a sticky call bar. render.json: no overflow at 320 or 390.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section with the brake pin unrolled into a static list. One h1, decoder tabs, forced-colors and print styles in dist/index.html, render.json clean. The grey '— SCAN LIST' / '— BEFORE YOU CALL' eyebrows on near-black (1440-scroll-50.jpg) are small, light mono and still look close to 4.5:1.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the brake pin thins the pad per step, motion that explains, but the readout says '2 mm' while the active step is 'PAD 3 MM' (-0.5, the number is the promise). 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the ROW 08 / 08 counter tracks the scan list. The road-test chart (1440-full.jpg) shows no drawn-on state in any frame, and printouts and drop-off show one generic reveal (-0.5 from 9.5).

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the warning-light decoder answers in the signature language. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the millimetre brake story. 1440-full.jpg: the I-90 misfire chart makes 'we drive it the way you do' visible. Not a 10: the decoder still doesn't hand off to the brake story, and its answer can't be kept or texted.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: square system, Sample pills as the one rounded exception, designed green footer close with tabular phone. dist/index.html: favicon, og:image, AutoRepair JSON-LD, print and forced-colors. Not higher: the proof line wrap in 1440-first.jpg and the 2 mm / 3 mm mismatch in 1440-scroll-75.jpg are the kind of seams a jury spots.

elevate.move: Make every number on the page a live reading: the brake readout ticks in lockstep with the active step, the road-test traces draw left to right and the misfire window flashes as the I-90 headline lands, and each scan row types its mono label before the title, so the signature moves the same way in four places instead of one.

Give the drawings one real-world anchor: a single sharp photograph of a probe on a connector or a car on the lift, framed in the same LIVE DATA chrome with a mono reading in its header and the plain sentence as caption, so the instrument language reaches the physical shop.
